both texts are equally authentic.
For the Government of Russian Federation
For the Republic of Rwanda

articles.heading: Intego z'ubufatanye 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bibinyujije mu nzego zabyo zibifitiye
articles.text:
ububasha, ibigo byemerewe mu Rwanda
n’ibigo byemerewe n’Uburusiya bigomba
gufatanya mu gushaka ahantu ho kubaka,
kubaka, kugenzura, gukora n’isozwa
ry’Ikigo cy’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga
rya Nikeleyeri ku butaka bwa Repubulika
y’u Rwanda (muri aya Masezerano yiswe
-Ikigo).
Ikigo kizaba kirimo ahazakorerwa
ubushakashatsi bwa Nikeleyeri,
gishingiye ku bushakashatsi
butandukanye bw’amashanyarazi aturuka
ku mazi afite ubushobozi bugera kuri MW
10, bugizwe n'ibikoresho biri ku murongo
neza, ibikoresho bikenewe kugira ngo
gikore neza, ama laboratwari n’andi mazu
yo gukorerwamo, ibikorwa remezo
by’ubwubatsi na tekiniki n’ibindi
bikoresho, harimo n’ibikoresho bya
nikeleyeri.
2. Bishingiye ku byihutirwa bijyanye
n’umutekano wa nikeleyeri
n’uw’imirasire yangiza, ibihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano biharanira ko inzego
zabyo zibishinzwe zikora mu bijyanye
n’imikoreshereze y’ingufu za nikeleyeri
zizajya zitangira ku gihe ibyangombwa
(impushya), bisabwa kugira ngo aya
Masezerano ashyirwe mu bikorwa
hakurikijwe amategeko agenga ibihugu
byabo, by’umwihariko ku bijyanye no
gushaka aho Ikigo kizakorera n’aho
kizubakwa, kohereza no gutumiza mu
mahanga ibikoresho (harimo no gutumiza
mu mahanga by'igihe gito), gukora
imirimo, gutanga serivisi, ndetse no
kugenzura, n’isozwa ry’imirimo yo
kubaka Ikigo.
3. Kugira ngo habeho ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’umushinga w’ubwubatsi
bw’Ikigo mu buryo bwiza kandi
butekanye, ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bifatanya mu iterambere
ry’ibikorwa remezo bikoreshwa ku ngufu
za nikeleyeri bya Repubulika y’u Rwanda
(harimo na gahunda y’igihugu ijyanye
n’umutekano w’ingufu za nikeleyeri
n’uw’imirasire yangiza mu rwego rwo
gukoresha ingufu za nikeleyeri) bikenewe
mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya gahunda
y’ingufu za nikeleyeri ya Repubulika y’u
Rwanda hashingiwe ku bikorwa
by’Uburusiya kandi hubahirizwa
ibyifuzonama by’Ikigo Mpuzamahanga
gishinzwe ingufu za kirimbuzi.

articles.heading: Ingeri z’ubufatanye Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishyigikira ubufatanye, buteganyijwe mu
articles.text:
ngingo ya mbere y’aya Masezerano mu
ngeri zikurikira:
- iterambere ry’ibikorwa remezo bya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda bijyanye
n’ingufu za nikeleyeri bikenewe mu
gushyira mu bikorwa ubufatanye mu
iyubakwa ry’Ikigo;
- guhitamo aho kubaka, kugenzura,
gushyira ku murongo imirimo yo kubaka,
imikorere, serivisi zo gusigasira no
gusoza imirimo y’ubwubatsi bw’Ikigo ;
- amahugurwa y'abakozi ku bijyanye
n’imikorere no kubungabunga imirimo
y’ubwubatsi bw’Ikigo;
- guteza imbere gahunda y’igihugu
ishinzwe umutekano w’ingufu za
nikeleyeri n’uw’imirasire yangiza mu mu
ngeri yo gukoresha ingufu za nikeleyeri
muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda, ndetse no
guhugura abakozi b’Urwego rw’Igihugu
rushinzwe kugenzura imirimo imwe
n'imwe ifitiye igihugu akamaro;
- izindi ngeri z’ubufatanye zishobora
kwemezwa n’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano mu nyandiko binyuze mu
nzira za dipolomasi.

articles.heading: Intego z'Ikigo Intego z'ibanze z'Ikigo ni
articles.text:
- gukora radio-isotopes hagamijwe
ubuvuzi, inganda n’ubuhinzi;
- ubushakashatsi bw’ubugenge ku ngufu
za kirimbuzi n’ibikorwa byakozwe
harimo no gukuraho urumuri rw’agace
gato k’akanyabutabire kiswe neutron ;
- ubushakashatsi bw’ibikoresho
by’ubwubatsi n’ibikoresho byihariye ;
- amahugurwa y’inzobere
n’ubushakashatsi bujyanye mu rwego rwa
gahunda y’igihugu y’ingufu za nikeleyeri
ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda mu bijyanye
no gukoresha ingufu za nikeleyeri
hagamijwe amahoro;
- guteza imbere uburezi mu ngeri
z’ubumenyi n’ubuhanga mu
by’ubwubatsi;
- kwizeza umutekano w’ingufu za
nikeleyeri n’uw’imirasire yangiza mu
rwego rwo gukoresha ingufu za
Nikeleyeri no kurengera ibidukikije;
- guteza imbere gahunda y’umutekano
w’ingufu za nikeleyeri n’imirasire
yangiza mu bijyanye no gukoresha ingufu
za nikeleyeri, bisabwa kugira ngo
gahunda y’igihugu y’ingufu za nikeleyeri
ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda ishyirwe mu
bikorwa ;
- izindinngeri zikoreshwa n’ingufu za
nikeleyeri ku mpamvu z’amahoro.

articles.heading: Inzego zibifitiye ububasha n’Ibigo byemerewe 1. Ku bw’aya Masezerano, ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigena
articles.text:
inzego zibifitiye ububasha zikurikira:
Ku ruhande rw'u Rwanda inzego zibifitiye
ububasha ni Minisiteri y'Ibikorwa
Remezo bya Repubulika y'u Rwanda
hamwe n’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe
kugenzura imirimo imwe n'imwe ifitiye
igihugu akamaro (mu bijyanye no
kugenzura umutekano w’ingufu za
nikeleyeri n’uw’imirasire yangiza,
kugenzura umutekano w’ibikoresho
by’ingufu za nikeleyeri, ibikorwa bibyara
ingufu za nikeleyeri, inkomoko
y’imirasire yangiza, ububiko
bw’ibikoresho by’ingufu za nikeleyeri
n'ibikoresho byifitemo imirasire yangiza,
gahunda yo kubara no kugenzura
ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu ngufu za
nikeleyeri, ibikoresho byifitemo imirasire
yangiza n’imyanda yifitemo imirasire
yangiza);
Ku ruhande rw’u Burusiya inzego
zibifitiye ububasha ni Ikigo cy’Igihugu
gishinzwe ingufu za nikeleyeri "Rosatom"
n’Ikigo gishinzwe serivisi mu bijyanye
n’ubugenzuzi bw’ibidukikije,
ikoranabuhanga n’akanyabutabire
katagaragarira ijisho (ku binjyanye no
kugenzura umutekano w’ingufu za
nikeleyeri n’uw’imirasire yangiza,
kugenzura ibijyanye no kurinda
ibikoresho by’ingufu za nikeleyeri,
ibikorwa bibyara ingufu za nikeleyeri,
inkomoko y’imirasire yangiza, ahantu ho
kubika ibikoresho by’ingufu za nikeleyeri
n'ibikoresho byifitemo imirasire yangiza,
gahunda yo kubara no kugenzura
ibikoresho bikoresha ingufu za nikeleyeri,
ibikoresho by’imirasire yangiza
n’imyanda yifitemo imirasire yangiza,
n'amahugurwa y'abakozi b'Ikigo
gishinzwe kugenzura imirimo imwe
n’imwe ifitiye igihugu akamaro).
2. Inzego zibifitiye ububasha zo ku
ruhande rw’u Rwanda zigena ibigo
byemerewe mu Rwanda, harimo
n'umukiriya. Inzego zibifitiye ububasha
zo ku ruhande rw'Uburusiyazigena ibigo
byemerewe n’Uburusiya, harimo na
rwiyemezamirimo mukuru. Inzego
zibifitiye ububasha z’ibihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano bihanahana amakuru
arebana n'ibigo byashyizweho mu
nyandiko.
3. Mu gihe habaye impinduka izo ari zo
zose mu nzego zibifitiye ububasha,
amazina yazo cyangwa ibyo bakora
cyangwa kugena izindi nzego zibifitiye
ububasha ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bigomba guhita
bibimenyeshanya mu nyandiko binyuze
mu nzira za dipolomasi. Mu gihe habaye
impinduka cyangwa kugena ibindi bigo
byemewe by’u Rwanda cyangwa ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya, harimo
rwiyemezamirimo mukuru n’umukiriya,
inzego zibifitiye ububasha
zimenyeshanya mu nyandiko.
4. Ibigo byemerewe n’u Rwanda n’ibigo
byemerewe n’Uburusiya bigomba mu
bijyanye n’aya Masezerano ibigo by’u
Rwanda (muri aya Masezerano byitwa
"ba rwiyemezamirimo" bo mu Rwanda),
ibigo by’Uburusiya (muri aya
Masezerano byitwa ba rwiyemezamirimo
bo mu Burusiya) kimwe n’ibindi bigo
by’ibindi bihugu bitanga ibikoresho,
gushyira mu bikorwa imirimo no gutanga
serivisi.
5. Inzego zibifitiye ububasha z'ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano zigomba
guhuza ubufatanye hagati y’ibigo
byemerewe n’u Rwanda n’ibigo
byemerewe n’Uburusiya hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’aya Masezerano kandi
ikagenzura ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’ingamba zo gushyira mu bikorwa mu
buryo bukwiye aya Masezerano.
6. Mu rwego rwo kugenzura neza no
gufata ingamba zikwiye zo gushyira mu
bikorwa aya Masezerano, inzego
zibifitiye ububasha z’ibihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano zikorera muri komite
mpuzabikorwa ihuriweho n’ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 6
y’Amasezerano hagati ya Guverinoma ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda na Guverinoma
Yunze Ubumwe y’Uburusiya ku bijyanye
n’ubufatanye mu ngeri yo gukoresha
ingufu za nikeleyeri hagamijwe amahoro
yo ku wa 5 Ukuboza 2018.

articles.heading: Imikorere y’ibigo byemerewe n’amategeko 1. Rwiyemezamirimo mukuru n’umukiriya hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
articles.text:
n’aya Masezerano bagomba kugirana
amasezerano rusange ajyanye
n’ubushakashatsi mu bijyanye
n’ubuhanga bw’ubwubatsi, imirimo yo
mu gihe cy’imyiteguro n’imirimo
ibanziriza umushinga, igishushanyo
mbonera, kuboneka kw’ibikoresho,
kubaka no kugenzura inyubako z’Ikigo
bigaragaza ibice byihariye bigize imirimo
yakozwe, ibikoresho na serivisi
byatanzwe, ibiciro, ibisabwa mu
kwishyura, igihe ntarengwa cyo kuzuza
inshingano, kugena birambuye
inshingano hagati ya rwiyemezamirimo
mukuru n'umukiriya hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’aya Masezerano,
n'inshingano zabo (muri aya Masezerano
yitwa "rwiyemezamirimo mukuru").
2. Igihe cyo gukosora amakosa yabaye mu
mirimo itandukanye yo kubaka Ikigo ni
amezi 24 uhereye umunsi
rwiyemezamirimo mukuru n’umukiriya
w’igikorwa cyo kugenzura inyubako
y’Ikigo bashyiriyeho umukono.
3. Uruhande rw’u Rwanda ruharanira
iyuzuzwa ry’inshingano bikozwe n’ibigo
byemerewe mu Rwanda bibikorera ibigo
byemerewe n’Uburusiya, harimo
n’inshingano zo kwishyura imirimo
yakozwe, itangwa ry’ibikoresho na
serivisi.
4. Amasezerano hagati y’ibigo
byemerewe n’u Rwanda n’ibigo
byemerewe n’Uburusiya hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n'aya Masezerano bizakorwa
nyuma yo kubona ibyavuye mu
mishyikirano itaziguye hagati y’ibigo
byemerewe n’u Rwanda n’ibigo
byemerewe n’Uburusiya gukura
ibikoresho ahantu hamwe. Inzego
zibifitiye ububasha z'uruhande rw’u
Rwanda zitegura kubona ibyangombwa
bikwiye kugira ngo hakorwe amasezerano
ataziguye hagati y’ibigo byemerewe
n’Uburusiya n’ibigo byemerewe n’u
Rwanda hakurikijwe amategeko ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda.
Amasezerano yakozwe hagati y’ibigo
byemerewe n’u Rwanda na ba
rwiyemezamirimo kandi agashyirwaho
umukono na ba rwiyemezamirimo bo mu
Rwanda azakorwa hakurikijwe
amategeko ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda.
Amasezerano yakozwe hagati y’ibigo
byemerewe n’Uburusiya na ba
rwiyemezamirimo kandi agashyirwaho
umukono na ba rwiyemezamirimo bo mu
Burusiya akorwa hakurikijwe amategeko
ya Guverinoma Yunze Ubumwe
y’Uburusiya.
5. Ku mpamvu zo gutanga ibicuruzwa,
gushyira mu bikorwa imirimo no gutanga
serivisi hakurikijwe aya Masezerano,
impande zombi zemeranya gukurikiza
amategeko ngenderwaho n’ibipimo fatizo
bikurikizwa muri Guverinoma Yunze
Ubumwe y’Uburusiya ku bijyanye
n’igishushanyombonera, kubaka,
gutangiza no gukora kw’imirimo yo
kubaka Ikigo.

articles.heading: Inshingano za rwiyemezamirimo mukuru Ku mpamvu zo gushyira mu bikorwa ubufatanye hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
articles.text:
n’aya Masezerano, uruhande
rw’Uburusiya rwemeza ko
rwiyemezamirimo mukuru agomba
gukurikiza amasezerano rusange mu bintu
bikurikira:
- gukora ubushakashatsi bujyanye
n’ubuhanga bw’imyubakire aho Ikigo
cyubakwa;
- gufasha umukiriya mu gutegura
inyandiko zerekana isuzuma ry’Ikigo ku
byerekeye ingaruka ku bidukikije no
gusobanura impamvu yo guhitamo aho
Ikigo kigomba kubakwa;
- gufasha umukiriya gukora neza raporo
y’isesengura ry’umutekano w’Ikigo ;
- gukora no gutegura inyandiko z'ibanze
kandi zikubiyemo ibisobanuro birambuye
(zidafite uburyo zirinzwe mu buryo
bugaragarira ijisho) hakurikijwe
amategeko ngenderwaho n’ibipimo fatizo
by’Uburusiya bikurikizwa ku
mikoreshereze y’ingufu za nikeleyeri
kandi hakurikijwe n’ibyifuzo by’Ikigo
mpuzamahanga gishinzwe ingufu za
nikeleyeri;
- gutanga ubufasha mu bijyanye na
tekiniki bwo gutegura ibyangombwa
bikenewe kugira ngo umuntu abone
ibyangombwa (impushya) zo gushaka aho
kubaka, kubaka no kugenzura inyubako
Ikigo kizakoreramo hakurikijwe ibisabwa
n'amategeko ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
- gukora imirimo yo kubaka, gushyiraho
no gukora imirimo y’ibanze ndetse no
kugenzura ko inyubako z’Ikigo zujuje
ibisabwa ;
- gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo uwakoze
igishushanyo mbonera yakoze no
kugenzura ibipimo by’umushinga mu
byiciro byose byo kubaka Ikigo no
kugenzura ubuziranenge bw’inyubako
z’Ikigo;
- gucunga neza ireme ry’ibikorwa
byakozwe, n’ibikoresho byatanzwe;
- gukora no gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda
yo gucunga neza mu byiciro byose byo
kubaka Ikigo;
- kohereza impuguke n’inzobere
z’Uburusiya muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda hashingiwe ku biteganywa
n’amasezerano rusange;
- gutanga ibikoresho, hashingiwe ku
ngano n’intera ihuye n’ibipimo
n’ibisobanuro bikubiye mu masezerano
rusange. Igipimo cy'ibikoresho bitangwa
kigomba kuba gikubiyemo ibikoresho byo
gusimbura hakurikijwe ibipimo fatizo
ngenderwaho n’ababikora mu gihe cyo
gutangira gukora imirimo, kugenzura
imyubakire y’inyubako z’Ikigo kugira
ngo habeho igihe cyo gukosora amakosa
yagaragaye mu nyubako z’Ikigo,
n’ibikoresho byihariye; n'ibikoresho byo
gushyira ku nyubako no gutangiza
imirimo, serivisi zo kubungabunga no
gusana ibikoresho hubahirijwe inyandiko
ya tekiniki y’ababikoze hakurikijwe
amategeko n'amabwiriza yemeranyijweho
mu masezerano rusange. Gutanga
ibikoresho bigomba gukorerwa aho Ikigo
kigomba kubakwa;
- gutanga ubwoko bwihariye
bw’ibikoresho byo kubaka, gushyiraho no
gutangiza imirimo kimwe no gusuzuma
inyubako z’Ikigo bikorwa mu gihe cyo
gutumiza mu mahanga by'agateganyo
ibikoresho;
- gukora ibikorwa byo gushyiraho,
kugenzura, gusuzuma ibikoresho
byatanzwe na Guverinoma Yunze
Ubumwe y’Uburusiya n'ibyatanzwe
n'ibindi bihugu, gutanga ubufasha bwa
tekiniki mu gihe cyagenwe cyo gukosora
amakosa y'imikorere yabyo;
- gutanga amavuta akomoka kuri
nikeleyeri hakoreshejwe ibikoresho
byagenewe ibicanwa mu gihe cyo kubaka
Ikigo mu rwego rwo gushyira ibicanwa
mu bikoresho no kuyamena bwa mbere;
- gutanga inkomoko y’akanyabutabire
gato mu rwego rwo gutangiza ibikorwa
by’ubushakashatsi bw’ingufu za
nikeleyeri n’inkomoko y’imirasire
yangiza kugira ngo hashyirwemo amavuta
mu bikoresho bigira imirasire yangiza
bikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi by’Ikigo mu
gihe cyo kubaka Ikigo ;
- Gutegura amahugurwa, amahugurwa
y’imyuga yo ku rwego ruhanitse
n’amahugurwa y’abakozi b’u Rwanda mu
rwego rwo kugira uruhare mu
gushyirwaho, kugenzura no gukora
kw’Ikigo mu rwego ruteganyijwe mu
masezerano rusange;
- kwimura mu buryo bwumvikanweho
inyandiko za tekiniki ku bikoresho
bitangwa n’ababikora baturutse muri
Guverinoma Yunze Ubumwe
y’Uburusiya.

articles.heading: Inshingano z'umukiriya Ku mpamvu zo gushyira mu bikorwa ubufatanye hakurikijwe aya Masezerano,
articles.text:
Igihugu cy’u Rwanda giharanira ko
hakurikijwe amasezerano rusange,
umukiriya agomba:
- guhitamo ahantu ho kubaka Ikigo, guha
aho kubaka rwiyemezamirimo mukuru no
gutuma ibikozwe n’abakozi b'ibigo
byemerewe n'Uburusiya n'ibigo
byemerewe n'u Rwanda bahagira
uburenganzira;
- gutanga amakuru y’ibanze ahari kandi
yizewe akenewe mu rwego rwo
gusobanura neza impamvu yo guhitamo
ahazubakwa Ikigo n’igishushanyo
mbonera cyacyo n’amafaranga bizatwara,
ibisabwa gukorwa mu gihe cyagenwe
kandi cyumvikanweho na
rwiyemezamirimo mukuru bikaba bireba
umukiriya ;
- gutegura raporo yerekeye isuzuma
ry’ingaruka Ikigo kizagira ku bidukikije ;
- gutegurira Ikigo raporo z’isesengura ku
bijyanye n’umutekano ;
- gushushanya no kubaka mu buryo
bwemeranyijweho na rwiyemezamirimo
mukuru kandi hakurikijwe ibisabwa na
rwiyemezamirimo mukuru bijyanye na
tekiniki, inyubako z’Ikigo ziherereye
hanze y’ahubakwa Ikigo, harimo
ibikoresho bitanga amazi
n’amashanyarazi, uburyo bwo kohereza
no kugera ku mihanda igana ahazubakwa
Ikigo ;
- guteza imbere no gushyira mu bikorwa
gahunda zo gucunga neza imirimo ikorwa
na ba rwiyemezamirimo bo mu Rwanda
mu byiciro byose byo kubaka Ikigo ;
- gufasha ibigo byemerewe n’u Rwanda
na ba rwiyemezamirimo bo mu Rwanda
kubona ibyangombwa (impushya) harimo
izitangwa n’Urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe
kugenzura imirimo imwe n’imwe ifitiye
igihugu akamaro (RURA) bisabwa
hakurikijwe amategeko ya Repubulika
y’u Rwanda kugira ngo aya Masezerano
ashyirwe mu bikorwa, harimo impushya
zisabwa ibigo by’u Rwanda byemewe mu
rwego rwo gutwara amavuta akomoka
kuri nikeleyeri n’inkomoko y’imirasire
yangiza ku butaka bwa Repubulika y’u
Rwanda, hamwe n’uburenganzira
(impushya) bwo gutwara amavuta
akomoka kuri nikeleyeri n’imirasire
yangiza ku butaka bw’ibindi bihugu;
- gukora no gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba
z'umutekano zisabwa zijyanye no kurinda
mu buryo bugaragara ahubakwa Ikigo,
n’ingamba z’umutekano zemeranijwe na
rwiyemezamirimo mukuru w’inzobere
z’Uburusiya n’inzobere z’ibindi bihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bari
ahubakwa Ikigo;
- kurindira umutekano abakozi b’ibigo
byemerewe n’Uburusiya, abakozi
bakoreshwa na ba rwiyemezamiromo
b’Uburusiya n’inzobere baturutse mu
bindi bihugu bidahuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bari ahubakwa Ikigo, harimo
umutekano w’abakozi n’imiryango yabo
aho baba ;
- gutanga amacumbi aho Ikigo cyubakwa,
ibiro aho Ikigo cyubakwa, inyubako na
serivisi z’ubuvuzi (harimo serivisi
z’ubuvuzi bwihutirwa) hamwe
n’ibikoresho by’imibereho myiza
y’abakozi b’ibigo byemerewe
n’Uburusiya, abashoramari bo mu
Burusiya n’abakozi b’ibindi bihugu
boherejwe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'aya
Masezerano mu rwego rugomba
kumvikanwaho mu masezerano rusange;
- guha rwiyemezamirimo mukuru ku gihe
cya ngombwa cyo kubaka Ikigo
ibikoresho nkenerwa birimo
amashanyarazi (ingano yumvikanweho
n’ibipimo bya tekiniki bikwiye), amazi
y’inganda n’amazi meza (ibipimo
byumvikanweho n’ireme rikwiye), isuku,
imihanda yifashishwa harimo no gutwara
ibimashini bishinzwe, mu gihe kirekire,
gukora ibikoresho byifashishwa mu
bwubatsi n’ibindi bikoresho (mu rwego
rw’ibikubiye mu masezerano
yumvikanweho);
- koroshya kubona viza zo kwinjira
n’impushya z’akazi, ku bakozi b’ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya n’abashoramari
bo mu Burusiya boherejwe muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda mu rwego rwo
gushyira mu bikorwa aya Masezerano
(harimo n’abagize imiryango yabo);
- kubungabunga umutekano w’ahubakwa
Ikigo kimwe n’uw’ibikoresho, ibyuma
byifashishwa, n'ibikoresho bisimbura
bisabwa mu rwego rwo kubaka Ikigo
kandi biherereye ahakorerwa imirimo yo
kubaka Ikigo, harimo ibikoresho, ibyuma
byifashishwa n'ibikoresho bisimbura
byatanzwe na Guverinoma Yunze
Ubumwe y’Uburusiya n’ibindi bihugu ;
- gutanga abakozi babifitiye ubushobozi
mu gihe cy’imirimo yo gutangira no
gukoresha inyubako z’Ikigo;
- gutanga abakozi babifitiye ubushobozi
gukora ku Kigo mu byiciro bijyanye no
kubaka Ikigo, harimo abakozi bashinzwe
isuku ku biro n’inyubako
zitunganyirizwamo ibikoresho;
- guha rwiyemezamirimo mukuru
amakuru n’inyandiko zisabwa mu rwego
rwo gushyira mu bikorwa aya
Masezerano;
- guha Ikigo ibikoresho bifite ubushobozi
bwo kugenzura bizafasha guhita
byohereza amakuru mu Kigo
mpuzamahanga gishinzwe ingufu za
nikeleyeri binyuze mu muyoboro wizewe
utangwa n’Ikigo mpuzamahanga
gishinzwe ingufu za nikeleyeri;
- kugenzura no gusuzuma iyubahirizwa
ry'ibisabwa byemejwe ku bikoresho
bikoreshwa mu kubaka no gushyirwa mu
Kigo;
- gutanga inkunga isanzwe, mu gihe
gikwiye kandi ku gihe cy’imirimo yose
hakurikijwe amasezerano yakozwe
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'aya
Masezerano.

articles.heading: Gutanga amavuta n'amasoko 1. Uruhande rw’Uburusiya ruharanira gutanga ibikoresho bikozwe n’ibigo
articles.text:
byemerewe by’Uburusiya, mu gihe
uruhande rw’u Rwanda ruharanira ko
amasoko ahoraho y’ibigo byemerewe
by’u Rwanda mu gihe cyose cy’ibikorwa
by’Ikigo mu gihe kirekire
cyumvikanweho (binyuze mu
masezerano) hashingiwe ku biciro
byumvikanweho (hashingiwe ku biciro
bikurikizwa ku rwego rw’isi) bya:
- amavuta akomoka kuri nikeleyeri
yashyizwe mu bikoresho byabugenewe
byakorewe muri Guverinoma Yunze
Ubumwe y’Uburusiya kugira ngo
akoreshwe mu Kigo ku ngano isabwa mu
rwego rwo gushyira amavuta mu
bikoresho byabugenewe bwa mbere no
kongerwamo bikorwa nyuma mu gihe
cyose cy’ikoreshwa ry’Ikigo;
- kugenzura ibikoresho bishyirwamo
amavuta byakorewe muri Guverinoma
Yunze Ubumwe y’Uburusiya ku mubare
ukenewe kugira ngo ibikorwa byose
by’ubushakashatsi bukomatanyije
bw’igikoresho gitanga amashanyarazi
y’Ikigo;
- ibikoresho fatizo byakorewe muri
Guverinoma Yunze Ubumwe
y’Uburusiya bisabwa mu gukora isotope
mu gihe cyose cy’imikorere y’Ikigo;
- inkomoko z’utunyabutabire duto
n’inkomoko z’imirasire yangiza
yakorewe muri Guverinoma Yunze
Ubumwe y’Uburusiya mu gihe cyose
cy’imikorere y’Ikigo.
2. Gutanga ibikoresho bishyirwamo
amavuta bisabwa kugira ngo bikoreshwe
mu Kigo mu gushyiramo amavuta bwa
mbere no kongeramo amavuta bikorwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa mu masezerano
rusange. Gutanga amavuta hakoreshjwe
uburyo bwo kongeramo amavuta bikorwa
nyuma y’igihe cyose cy’imikorere y’Ikigo
bikorwa hashingiwe ku masezerano
yihariye.
3. Gutanga inkomoko z’utunyabutabire
duto, dukenewe mu rwego rwo gutangira
gukoresha ibikoresho mu bikorwa
by’ubushakashatsi bujyanye na nikeleyeri
n’inkomoko y’imirasire yangiza kugira
ngo itangire kwinjizwa mu bikoresho
byifitemo imirasire yangiza y’Ikigo
bikorwa hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’amasezerano rusange. Gutanga
imirasire yangiza mu rwego rwo
gushyiramo bwa mbere no kongeramo
gukorwa nyuma yaho mu gihe cyose
cy’imikorere y’Ikigo bikorwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’amasezerano
yihariye.

articles.heading: Serivisi zo gufata neza ibikoresho Uruhande rw’Uburusiya rwemeza amategeko bikozwe n’ibigo byemerewe
articles.text:
by’Uburusiya, mu gihe uruhande ry’u
Rwanda ruzakomeza gutanga amasoko
bikozwe n’ibigo byemerewe by’u
Rwanda kugira ngo bibungabunge serivisi
za tekiniki z’ibikoresho byatanzwe,
harimo ubujyanama, gutanga ibikoresho
bisimbura, gutanga ikoranabuhanga mu
rwego rwo kubungabunga mu buryo bwa
tekiniki no kubika ibikoresho, ubufasha
mu itunganywa rya serivisi zo gusana no
kubungabunga imirimo yo gukosora
amakosa yabonetse nyuma mu gihe cyose
cy’imikorere y’Ikigo, mu gihe kirekire
cyumvikanweho (binyuze mu
masezerano) ku biciro byumvikanweho.

articles.heading: Ibikorwa remezo bya nikeleyeri 1. Uruhande rw’u Rwanda ruharanira ko ibikorwa remezo bya nikeleyeri biboneka
articles.text:
mu rwego rwo kubaka, gukoreshwa no mu
mikorere y’Ikigo.
2. Ibigo byemerewe by’u Rwanda n’ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya mu rwego
rw’amasezerano yihariye bisuzuma kandi
bifasha mu ishyirwaho ry’ibikorwa
remezo by’ingufu za nikeleyeri bya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda bisabwa
hagamijwe ishyirwa mu bikorwa rifite
ireme kandi ryizewe ry’iyubakwa
ry’Ikigo hakurikijwe ibyifuzo by'Ikigo
mpuzamahanga gishinzwe ingufu za
nikeleyeri.

articles.heading: Gucunga imyanda yifitemo imirasire yangiza Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifatanya mu bijyanye no gukoresha
articles.text:
amavuta ya nikeleyeri yakoreshejwe
n’imyanda yifitemo imirasire yangiza no
kuyivana mu nyubako z’Ikigo zubatswe
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano hakurikijwe amasezerano
yihariye na yo agomba kumvikanwaho
n’Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano.

articles.heading: Uburyozwe ku byangizwa na nikeleyeri 1. Amagambo akoreshwa muri aya Masezerano afite ibisobanuro
articles.text:
byagaragajwe mu Masezerano y'i Vienne
yerekeye uburyozwe ku byangijwe na
nikeleyeri yo ku wa 21 Gicurasi 1963.
2. Uburyozwe ku byangijwe na nikeleyeri
byatewe n’ikibazo cya nikeleyeri cyabaye
mu gihe cyo kubika amavuta mashya ya
nikeleyeri cyangwa mu gihe
cy’ubwikorezi bwayo, Ikigo cyemerewe
cy’Uburusiya cyimurira mu kigo
cyemerewe cy’u Rwanda aho kuyikura
mu buryo bwakoreshejwe mu bwikorezi
yoherejwemo ku butaka bwa Repubulika
y'u Rwanda, hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n'amasezerano yakozwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n'aya Masezerano.
3. Mu gihe habaye ikibazo cya nikeleyeri
haba ahubakwa Ikigo cyangwa ku butaka
bwa Repubulika y’u Rwanda ndetse no
hanze yarwo, harimo n’ikibazo cyatejwe
na nikeleyeri cyabaye mu gihe cyo
kuyitwara (nyuma y’uburyozwe
bw’igikoresho cya nikeleyeri bikozwe
n’Ikigo cyemerewe cy’u Rwanda),
gutunganya cyangwa kubika amavuta ya
nikeleyeri (amavuta ya nikeleyeri
yakoreshejwe), imyanda yifitemo
imirasire yangiza cyangwa ibindi
bikoresho ibyo ari byo byose byanduye
cyangwa ibice ibyo ari byo byose
by’ibikoresho by’Ikigo, umukiriya ari we
nyir'Ikigokandiari we unakoresha Ikigo
yirengera uburyozwe bwose kandi
bwihariye bujyanye n’ibyangijwe na
nikeleyeri ku muntu uwo ari we wese
cyangwa ku mutungo biri ku Kigo ndetse
no ku butaka bwa Repubulika y'u Rwanda
ndetse no hanze y’imbibi zarwo.
Uruhande rw’u Rwanda rwizeza ko nta na
rimwe Uruhande rw’Uburusiya, inzego
zarwo zose zibifitiye ububasha, Ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya na ba
rwiyemezamirimob’abarusiya bafatwa
nk’ibakoresha Ikigo.
4. Uruhande ry’u Rwanda, abayobozi
baryo babifitiye ububasha, ibigo
byemerewe n’u Rwanda hamwe
n’abashoramari bo mu Rwanda bemeza
ko batazatanga ikirego icyo ari cyo cyose
kandi ko nta kirego kirega uruhande
ry’Uburusiya, abayobozi baryo babifitiye
ububasha, ibigo byemerewe n’Uburusiya
n’abashoramari bo mu Burusiya kijyanye
n’ibyangiritse ibyo ari byo byose byatewe
n’ibyabaye biturutse kuri nikeleyeri.
Uruhande rw’u Rwanda, abayobozi barwo
babifitiye ububasha, ibigo nyarwanda
byemerewe, abashoramari bo mu Rwanda
n’ibigo byabo by’ubwishingizi banga
uburenganzira bwo gusimbura uruhande
rw’Uburusiya, abayobozi babwo
babifitiye ububasha, ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo
b’Uburusiya ku birebana n’iyangirika
iryo ari ryo ryose ryatewe na nikeleyeri.
5. Uruhande rw'u Rwanda rwizeza ko
umukiriya ari we nyir'Ikigo akaba
n'umukoresha w'Ikigo nta kiguzi
cy’uruhande rw’Uburusiya, inzego zabwo
zibifitiye ububasha, ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo
b’Uburusiya yiyemeza kwishyura
amafaranga yose yakoreshejwe
n’uruhande rw’Uburusiya, inzego zabwo
zibifitiye ububasha, ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo bo
mu Burusiya kimwe no kurengerwa
n’amategeko bisabwa mu manza izo ari zo
zose yo gutanga ikirego cyangwa ibindi
birego bijyanye n’ibyangiritse byose
byatewe mu gihe habaye ibyangijwe na
nikeleyeri ku butaka bwa Repubulika y’u
Rwanda no hanze y’imbibi zarwo.

articles.heading: Kurinda Ikigo 1. Uruhande ry’u Rwanda rishinzwe kurinda Ikigo mu byiciro byose byo kucyubaka, gutangira kugikoresha,
articles.text:
imikorere no gusoza imirimo yacyo.
2. Uruhande rw’Uburusiya rufasha ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya muri ibi
bikurikira:
- gutanga serivisi z’ubujyanama mu
gushyiraho gahunda n’ingamba
z’ubuyobozi zo kurinda Ikigo;
- gutekereza, gukora imirimo yo kubaka
no gushyiraho no gutangiza ibikorwa
bikenewe kugira ngo hashyirweho uburyo
bwo kurindira umutekano inyubako
z’ibanze n’izizifasha z’Ikigo hashingiwe
ku biteganyijwe mu nyandiko y’Ikigo
mpuzamahanga gishinzwe ingufu za
kirimbuzi "Kurinda umutekano
w’ibikoresho n’inyubako bya nikeleyeri"
(INFCIRC /225/ isubiramo rya 5).
3. Uruhande rw'u Rwanda ruharanira:
- kugenzura ko inyubako yujuje ibisabwa
no gukoresha gahunda yo kurinda Ikigo
hakurikijwe amategeko ya Repubulika y'u
Rwanda kandi hakurikijwe ibitekerezo
byavuzwe mu nyandiko y’Ikigo
mpuzamahanga gishinzwe ingufu za
kirimbuzi "Kurinda igikoresho cya
nikeleyeri n'inyubako za nikeleyeri"
(INFCIRC/225/ Isubiramo rya 5)
cyangwa izindi nyandiko zishingiye kuri
zo zemewe n’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano;
- guha ibigo byemerewe by’Uburusiya
amakuru asabwa kugira ngo bitange
serivisi z’ubujyanama mu guteza imbere
gahunda n'ingamba z’ubuyobozi zo
kurinda no gutekereza, gukora, kubaka,
kwishyiriraho no gutangiza imirimo ya
ngombwa kugira ngo hashyirweho
gahunda yo kurinda inyubako z’ibanze
n’izifashishwa z’Ikigo.

articles.heading: Gusoresha 1. Ibibazo bijyanye n’imisoro bifitanye isano n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’aya Masezerano, bigengwa n’amategeko
articles.text:
y’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
mu gice kitagengwa n’iyi ngingo.
Uruhande rw'u Rwanda ruharanira ko:
- gusonerwa imisoro yose n’ibikorwa
bishishikariza bihabwa ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo bo
mu Burusiya hakurikijwe amategeko ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda. Iyo bibaye
ngombwa, habaho ukundi gusonerwa
n'ibindi bikorwa bishishikariza
by’inyongera;
- ku bakozi b’ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo
b’Uburusiya bumvikanweho n’inzego
zibifitiye ububasha z’ibihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano ibintu, ibikoresho,
ibikoreshwa mu kazi, imashini,
ibinyabiziga n’ibindi bikoresho
by’ubwikorezi, imirimo cyangwa serivisi,
bifitanye isano itaziguye cyangwa iziguye
bijyanye no gushyira mu bikorwa aya
Masezerano, byavanwe muri Guverinoma
Yunze Ubumwe y’Uburusiya bigomba
kwitabwaho mu buryo butari munsi cyane
y’uko ibicuruzwa na serivisi nk’ibyo
bitajyanye no gushyira mu bikorwa aya
Masezerano bifatwa. Nta buzwa cyangwa
ikumira, uko byaba byitwa kose, ryaba
ryarakozwe neza binyuze mu rugero
ntarengwa, impushya zo gutumiza
cyangwa kohereza mu mahanga cyangwa
ibicuruzwa hanze cyangwa izindi
ngamba, bizashyirwaho cyangwa ngo
bigumishweho n’uruhande rw’u Rwanda
ku bicuruzwa bitumizwa mu mahanga
cyangwa ibyoherezwa mu mahanga;
- ibibazo by'indishyi zijyanye n'imisoro
n'amahoro bifitanye isano n'aya
Masezerano bizakemurwa binyuze mu
masezerano akurikira ;
- kwishyura bitari mu rwego rw’imisoro
harimo ariko ntibigarukira gusa ku
mafaranga acibwa ku y’impushya yakwa
ibigo byemerewe by’Uburusiya mu rwego
rw’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’aya
Masezerano izishyurwa n’ibigo
byemerewe by’u Rwanda;
- ibiciro byose, amahoro, n’amafaranga
ateganywa n’uruhande rw’u Rwanda,
bizatangwa nta kumira iryo ari ryo ryose
cyangwa igabanya mu gihe cyo gushyira
mu bikorwa aya Masezerano, ku buryo
butavangura kandi ku mubare utarenze
amafaranga yishyuwe ashobora gusabwa
ku bindi bigo cyangwa abakozi bijyanye
n’ahantu hatoranyijwe cyangwa kugera
ku bikorwa remezo cyangwa gutanga
amazi cyangwa ibindi bikorwa rusange
n’imiyoboro, harimo ingufu
z’amashanyarazi, amazi yatunganijwe,
amazi meza, itumanaho, n’imihanda
n’ubwikorezi ku bigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya amashyirahamwe na ba
rwiyemezamirimo bo mu Burusiya,
byishyurwa n'uwabigenewe;
- imari shingiro n’umutungo bifitwe
cyangwa bikoreshwa, mu buryo buziguye
cyangwa butaziguye, n’ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo
b’abarusiya, ntibishobora kwimurwa,
kuba iby’igihugu, kunyagwa, guseswa
cyangwa gufatirwa keretse ku
bw’inyungu rusange, kandi hakurikijwe
gusa amategeko adashingiye ku ivangura,
kandi hatanzwe ingurane no kuba
hishyuwe ako kanya kandi mu buryo
bwuzuye bikozwe n’uruhande rw’u
Rwanda ku bihombo byose n’amafaranga
yose bibikomokaho.
2. Ibigo byemerewe by’Uburusiya na ba
rwiyemezamirimo b’abarusiya bafite
uburenganzira bukurikira:
- gufungura no kugumana konti imwe
cyangwa nyinshi muri banki bashaka
ikorera muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda ku
mafaranga y’amahanga cyangwa gufata
no gukoresha mu bwisanzure amafaranga
ayo ari yo yose yo hanze ya Repubulika
y'u Rwanda;
- gutanga mu mafaranga y’amahanga
avunjwa mu buryo bworoshye
amafaranga yose asabwa kugira ngo aya
Masezerano ashyirwe mu bikorwa kandi
bibaye ngombwa kuvunja ayo mafaranga
mu ifaranga ry’igihugu cy’u Rwanda
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'amategeko ya
Banki Nkuru ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda
mu rwego rwo kuzuza ibisabwa
byanditswe;
- gusubiza mu bwisanzure amafaranga
y’amahanga mu mahanga nta mbogamizi
iyo ari yo yose hakurikijwe amategeko ya
Banki Nkuru ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda
mu rwego rwo kuzuza ibisabwa mu
nyandiko;
- kwivanaho umutungo uwo ari wo wose
muri Repubulika y'u Rwanda, bimaze
kwishyura amahoro asabwa ku
byatumijwe mu mahanga na (cyangwa)
ya gasutamo cyangwa gukoresha
uburenganzira bwo kongera kohereza mu
mahanga, nta misoro n'amahoro yose
isabwe ku byoherezwa mu mahanga,
imitungo itagikenewe gukoreshwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'aya
Masezerano.
3. Ibigo by'abarusiya (kimwe n'ibiro
byabyo n'amashami byashinzwe ku
butaka bwa Repubulika y'u Rwanda)
bisonewe ubusabe ubwo ari bwo bwose
bw’amategeko ya Repubulika y'u Rwanda
ku bijyanye no gushaka abakozi b’imbere
mu gihugu ndetse n’ubusabe bwose
bw’amategeko bubuza guha akazi
abanyamahanga (harimo no gukurikiza
amategeko ayo ari yo yose asanzweho,
agabanya umubare w'abakozi
b'abanyamahanga bagomba kugira
uruhare mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'aya
Masezerano). Inzego zibifitiye ububasha
z'uruhande rw’u Rwanda zemeza kandi
zitegura itangwa rya viza zo kwinjira,
kubona impushya zo gukora n’izindi
mpushya zijyanye no kwinjiza abakozi
b’Uburusiya n'abakozi bava mu bindi
bihugu hashingiwe ku busabe bwemewe
n’amategeko bw’ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya.

articles.heading: Ubufatanye bw’inzego zishinzwe igenzura Ku mpamvu zo gushyira mu bikorwa ibiteganywa n’aya Masezerano yo
articles.text:
zigamije gushyiraho muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda igenzura ry’umutekano wa
nikeleyeri n’imirasire yangiza mu rwego
rwo gukoresha ingufu za nikeleyeri
zikenewe mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya
gahunda y’ingufu za nikeleyeri za
Repubulika y’u Rwanda, Inzego
zishinzwe kugenzura umutekano mu
rwego rwo gukoresha ingufu za kirimbuzi
z’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
zifatanya harimo uruhare rw’Ibigo
byemewe mu bijyanye n’umutekano wa
nikeleyeri n’imirasire yangiza, kugenzura
umutekano w’ibikoresho bya nikeleyeri,
inkomoko y’imirasire yangiza, ahantu ho
kubika ibikoresho bya nikeleyeri
n’ibikoresho bikoresha imirasire yangiza,
gahunda yo kubara no kugenzura
ibikoresho bikoresha imirasire yangiza,
n’imyanda yifitemo imirasire yangiza no
guhugura abakozi b’Urwego rw'Igihugu
rushinzwe kugenzura imikorere y'inzego
zimwe z'imirimo ifitiye Igihugu akamaro
(RURA).

articles.heading: Amategeko akurikizwa 1. Haseguriwe ibiteganywa n’iyi ngingo, amategeko ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda
articles.text:
yerekeranye n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’aya Masezerano yubahirizwa n’ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya n’ibigo
byemerewe by’u Rwanda, ba
rwiyemezamirimo bo mu Burusiya na ba
rwiyemezamirimo bo mu Rwanda
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano bigasaba ariko ko amategeko
cyangwa amavugururwa ayo ari yo yose
atangira gukurikizwa nyuma y'itariki yo
gushyira umukono kuri aya Masezerano
muri Repubulika y'u Rwanda ataba
anyuranya n'ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano.
2. Iyo amategeko mashya yemejwe muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda (usibye
amategeko agenga ibiciro, ibiciro
by’ingendo, amafaranga yishyurwa kuri
serivisi rusange muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda), atangira gukurikizwa nyuma
y’itariki yo gushyira umukono kuri aya
Masezerano kandi afite ingaruka mbi ku
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’aya Masezerano
na (cyangwa) amasezerano yakozwe
hakurikijwe ibiteganyijwe muri aya
Masezerano yangiza, abuza, anyuranya,
agabanya uburenganzira ubwo ari bwo
bwose, bigira ingaruka mbi ku kiguzi
cy’amasezerano, indishyi n’uburinzi
byatanzwe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri
aya Masezerano cyangwa biturutse kuri
aya Masezerano cyangwa amasezerano
yakozwe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri
aya Masezerano avangura mu buryo
butaziguye cyangwa buziguye cyangwa
atuma hacibwa amafaranga ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya cyangwa ba
rwiyemezamirimo bo mU Burusiya aya
mategeko ntazakoreshwa mu ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’aya Masezerano.
3. Hatitawe ku biteganywa mu gika cya 2
cy'iyi ngingo, ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo bo
mu Burusiya bagomba kubahiriza
amabwiriza mashya ayo ari yo yose
yatangajwe n’Urwego rw’Igihugu
rushinzwe kugenzura imikorere y’inzego
zimwe z’imirimo ifitiye Igihugu akamaro
nyuma y’itariki yo gushyira umukono kuri
aya Masezerano bisabye ko :
- indishyi zuzuye uruhande rw’u Rwanda
ruha ibigo byemerewe by’Uburusiya, ba
rwiyemezamirimo bo mu Burusiya ku byo
ari byo byose bijyanye n’igiciro,
ibihombo, amafaranga yakoreshejwe
cyangwa ukwangirika kwabayeho, mu
buryo buziguye cyangwa butaziguye,
biturutse ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’iryo
tegeko rishya;
- gusonera ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo
b’Uburusiya ibijyanye n’inshingano iyo
ari yo yose yo kutuzuza cyangwa
kutubahiriza neza inshingano zabo
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano zakozwe biturutse ku
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’iri tegeko rishya;
- uburenganzira bw’ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo
b’Uburusiya bwo guhagarika gukora
inshingano zabo hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
mu Masezerano ;
- Uburenganzira bugaragazwa mu gika
cya 3 cy’iyi ngingo, bw’ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya na ba rwiyemezamirimo
b’Uburusiya n’uburyo bukoreshwa
n’imikorere y’imikoreshereze yabwo
bigenwa mu masezerano hagati y’ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya n’ibigo
byemerewe by’u Rwanda.
4. Uruhande rw'u Rwanda rukora ku
buryo igikorwa giteganyijwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n'aya Masezerano bihuye
n’amategeko y’igihugu n'inyungu
z'umuryango kandi bitavuguruzanya.
5. Uruhande rw’u Rwanda rufasha ikigo
cyemerewe cy’u Rwanda mu rwego rwo
gushyiraho ibitekerezo byiza
by’abaturage ku bijyanye n’ingufu za
nikeleyeri muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda.

articles.heading: Amasezerano yakozwe hakurikijwe aya Masezerano 1. Mu gihe aya Masezerano avuguruzanya n’amasezerano yakozwe hagati y’ibigo
articles.text:
byemerewe by’u Rwanda n’ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya hagamijwe
gushyirwa mu bikorwa aya Masezerano
hubahirizwa ibivugwa muri aya
Masezerano.
2. Amasezerano yakozwe hagati y’ibigo
byemerewe by’u Rwanda n’ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya atanga
uburenganzira bw’ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya guhagarika ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’ayo masezerano mu gihe cyo:
- kutishyura ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya mu rwego rwo gushyira mu
bikorwa inshingano zabyo hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’amasezerano yakozwe;
- umukiriya na (cyangwa) ibindi bigo
byemerewe by’u Rwanda kunanirwa
kubona ibyangombwa bya ngombwa,
uburenganzira cyangwa ibyemezo
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano, ibigo byemerewe
by’Uburusiya bidashobora gukomeza
gushyira mu bikorwa inshingano zabyo
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri aya
masezerano;
- gutinda kubona impushya zisabwa
(ibyangombwa) byatewe no kwemeza
(kutemerwa) kw’ibyemezo by’inzego za
Repubulika y’u Rwanda, cyangwa
uruhande rw’u Rwanda cyangwa inzego
zibifitiye ububasha kurenga ku kuzuza
inshingano zabo hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
muri aya Masezerano, hashingiwe ko
ibigo byemerewe by’Uburusiya na ba
rwiyemezamirimo b’Uburusiya
bubahiriza neza amategeko ya Repubulika
y’u Rwanda;
- kutaboneka no (cyangwa) kudatangira
gukurikizwa kw'amategeko y'inzego za
Repubulika y'u Rwanda zikenewe mu
gushyira mu bikorwa neza ibiteganywa
n'aya Masezerano.
- Ibisabwa byihariye, birimo ibisabwa
by’inyongera hamwe n’uburyo bwo
guhagarika by’agateganyo ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’amasezerano yakozwe hagati
y’ibigo byemerewe n’Uburusiya n’ibigo
byemerewe by’u Rwanda bizashyirwa
muri aya Masezerano.
3. Impaka izo ari zo zose, impaka
cyangwa ibirego bituruka ku ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’amasezerano yakozwe hagati
y’ibigo byemerewe by’Uburusiya n’ibigo
byemerewe by’u Rwanda cyangwa
biterwa no kutubahiriza, guhagarika
cyangwa gusesa bizakemurwa n’urukiko
mpuzamahanga rw’ubukemurampaka
rw’ikindi gihugu, ruzagenwa n’impande
zihuriye kuri ayo masezerano, mu
bwumvikane. Icyemezo cy'urukiko
nkemurampaka kizaba ndakuka kandi
kigomba kubahirizwa n’ibihugu bigiranye
ayo masezerano.
4. Amasezerano yakozwe hagati y’ibigo
byemerewe by’u Rwanda n’ibigo
byemerewe by’Uburusiya n’imibanire
hagati y’ibihugu biturukamo bishingiye
kuri ayo masezerano (amasezerano),
bizagengwa kandi bisobanurwe
hakurikijwe amategeko y’ikindi gihugu,
bizagenwa n’ibihugu bigengwa n’ayo
masezerano binyuze mu bwumvikane.
5. Amasezerano (amasezerano) yakozwe
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano bishobora guhindurwa gusa,
guhagarikwa by’agateganyo cyangwa
guseswa n’impande zigengwa n’ayo
masezerano.

articles.heading: Gukemura amakimbirane 1. Amakimbirane yavuka hagati y’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano ajyanye no
articles.text:
gushyira mu bikorwa no (cyangwa)
gusobanura aya masezerano akemurwa
binyuze mu bugishwanama cyangwa
imishyikirano hagati y’inzego zibifitiye
ububasha, iyo ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bidashoboye kumvikana mu
bundi buryo.
2. Ku birebana n’ibindi bibazo
bidateganyijwe muri aya Masezerano,
harimo ibibazo byo kurinda amakuru
afatwa n’igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano cyiyohereje nk’ibanga, ibindi
bibazo ibyo ari byo byose bijyanye
n’umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
harimo kurengera umusaruro w’ibikorwa
by’ubwenge, kurinda umutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge w’ibanze n’umutungo bwite
mu by'ubwenge wabayeho mbere y’aya
Masezerano, wimurwa hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’aya Masezerano cyangwa
wahanzwe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano, ibikubiye muri aya
Masezerano hagati ya guverinoma ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda na guverinoma
Yunze Ubumwe y’Uburusiya ku
bufatanye mu rwego rwo gukoresha
ingufu za nikeleyeri ku mpamvu
z’amahoro, ku wa 5 Ukuboza 2018
birakurikizwa.

articles.heading: Gutangira gukurikiza, igihe, ivugururwa n’iseswa ry’aya Masezerano 1. Amasezerano atangira gukurikizwa
articles.text:
guhera umunsi, binyuze mu nzira za
dipolomasi imenyesha rya nyuma
ryanditse ryakiriweho mu nyandiko
rimenyesha ko ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano inzira zabyo za ngombwa ku
itangira gukurikizwa ryayo.
2. Aya Masezerano nta gihe amara afite
3. Aya Masezerano ashobora
kuvugururwa binyuze mu Masezerano
y’Inyongera atandukanye hagati
y’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano.
4. Buri gihugu mu bihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano gishobora gusesa aya
Masezerano cyoherereza ikindi kiri muri
aya Masezerano imenyesha ryanditse
rigaragaza umugambi wacyo wo gusesa
Amasezerano. Iyo bigenze bityo, aya
Masezerano atakaza agaciro umwaka
umwe nyuma yo kwakira iyo menyesha
ryanditse.
5. Iyo imenyesha ryanditse ryakiriwe na
kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano riturutse mu kindi gihugu
rimenyesha iseswa ry’aya Masezerano,
ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bihita bigisha inama ijyanye no kuzuza
inshingano zose zijyanye no kubaka no
kugenzura inyubako z’Ikigo n’ubufasha
bwa tekiniki mu gihe cyo kuryozwa
amakosa.
6. Mu gihe cyo gusesa aya Masezerano
inshingano zivugwa mu ngingo ya 8-13
z’aya Masezerano zikomeza gukurikizwa.
7. Gusesa aya Masezerano ntibishobora
kugira ingaruka ku gaciro k’amasezerano,
yakozwe hashingiwe kuri aya Masezerano
mu gihe cyo kuba agifite agaciro, no
kuzuza inshingano zayo.
Bikorewe i Sochi ku wa 24/10/2019 mu
nyandiko ebyiri ziri mu ndimi
z'Icyongereza n'Ikirusiya, inyandiko
zombi zinganya agaciro.
